{{Top|leg}}
A '''music player''' was a portable electronic device used to play [[Music/Legends|music]]. Its use required a [[Battery/Legends|battery]].

[[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] owned an antique music player called an [[Audiobulb]]. Its battery, as one of the Hutt's [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin]] [[Razor Eater]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] found out, was highly combustible.

At least one of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] or one of the collection of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] held on the harsh [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Despayre]] possessed a music player.
